brief.headline: Russia claims Bachevsk capture; Ukraine's Azov shipping strikes rattle bloggers
brief.lead: Channels celebrated the claimed seizure of Bachevsk in Sumy and a sustained missile-and-drone campaign against Kyiv and Odesa, but sentiment on Ukraine's escalating drone strikes against Russian ports and shipping turned sharply negative, alongside deepening alarm over Western rearmament.

developments.title: Multiple channels claim capture of Bachevsk in Sumy region
developments.body: Rybar, Two Majors, Kotsnews and Poddubny report Russia's 349th motorized rifles took Bachevsk, claiming heavy losses for Ukraine's 104th brigade and that defenders were trapped without evacuation. Claim is channel-sourced and unconfirmed; framed as improving Russia's border positions.

developments.title: Third Kyiv strike in a week hits drone makers, Odesa ports
developments.body: Channels claim combined strikes on Kyiv drone manufacturers Aerodrone and Fanplit plus three southern ports handling grain and military cargo. Rybar claims first-ever use of S-400 in a ground-to-ground role against Kyiv energy infrastructure; strike efficacy and targets are unconfirmed, largely MoD-echoed.

developments.title: Ukraine's Azov/Black Sea shipping strikes spark negative shift
developments.body: Rybar and Two Majors describe an expanding, systematic Ukrainian drone campaign against Russian ports and merchant/cargo vessels, including a Taganrog attack, a killed sailor, and a Sevastopol strike with reported Crimea power outages. Bloggers openly urge 'symmetric' retaliation on Ukrainian ports.

developments.title: Kyiv centralizes long-range drone command
developments.body: Rybar reports Zelensky created a centralized command structure for long-range strikes on Russia to cut bureaucracy, framed as a signal of intensifying deep-strike operations. Single-channel report.

developments.title: Alarm over Western rearmament drives NATO sentiment down
developments.body: Two Majors flags Germany acquiring Tomahawk/Typhon systems, Poland's domestic long-range Hornet drones (400-1200km), and an Estonian brigade base near the border by 2028. Kotsnews cites German Diehl-made Bars drones for Ukraine; Rybar warns of proposed US 500% secondary tariffs.

developments.title: Rare command criticism over air-defense against drones
developments.body: Two Majors argues Russian air defense against drones relies on reactive fire rather than preventive intelligence, a rare critical note amid otherwise triumphant framing. Single-channel.

narrative_watch.title: Demands for 'symmetric' retaliation on Ukrainian ports
narrative_watch.body: As Ukraine hits Azov/Black Sea shipping, bloggers increasingly frame the answer as mirror strikes on Ukrainian port and cargo infrastructure, building a justification narrative.

narrative_watch.title: Ukrainian draft enforcement framed as brutal repression
narrative_watch.body: Kotsnews claims Kyiv is crushing an anti-TCC 'Lviv uprising' with 60-day detentions and 8-year charges, reinforcing the internal-collapse frame.

narrative_watch.title: Strikes cast as precise hits on military-industrial targets
narrative_watch.body: Channels uniformly describe Kyiv/Odesa strikes as targeting drone plants, ports and defense industry, downplaying civilian impact and asserting air-defense penetration.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant across 14 posts; bloggers celebrate S-400 novelty, Kyiv drone-plant hits, and claimed destruction of 93 gas stations in early July.
Confident tone driven by claimed Bachevsk capture and advances near Pokrovsk, Kupyansk and Zaporizhzhia; all nine posts positive.
Sharply negative (net -100, down 25); alarm at systematic Ukrainian drone campaign on Azov shipping, Sevastopol and Belgorod region.
Down 36 points to net -54; anxiety over German Tomahawks, Polish drones, Estonian base and US secondary sanctions dominates.
Mixed; positive volunteer/evacuation stories offset by Gagauzia autonomy loss and framing of Ukrainian draft repression.
Single negative post: Two Majors faults reactive, intelligence-poor air-defense posture against drones.

flag_texts.title: Ukraine strikes on Russia sentiment drops 25 points
flag_texts.body: All 12 posts on the topic were negative (net -100), reflecting acute unease at Ukraine's expanding drone strikes on Russian ports and merchant shipping in the Azov and Black Seas, and calls for retaliation.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO mood falls 36 points to net -54
flag_texts.body: Coverage fixated on Western rearmament—German Tomahawk/Typhon buys, Polish long-range drones, Estonia's border brigade, and proposed US 500% secondary tariffs—driving sentiment sharply lower.

flag_texts.title: Watchlist topics silent: mobilisation and Putin criticism
flag_texts.body: No posts touched mobilisation rumours or criticism of Putin; the day's lone critical note targeted army air-defense doctrine, not the leadership.
